timeline.summary: Afari's Tales recount people leaving a barren land to hyenas and vipers.
timeline.quote: "The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."

citation.text: Choking Sands (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Afari's Tales tell of a snake's hiss for peace lost under the elephant's war trumpet.
timeline.quote: "But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."

citation.text: River Boa (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Afari's Tales tells of a man who traded his life for sand.
timeline.quote: In the end, he traded life for sand.
